summary.tpReason: Telemetry confirms successful IAM persistence and follow-on abuse from the alerted identity: a backdoor service account and key were created, granted project Owner, logging was disabled, sensitive objects were read, and GPU miner instances/firewall access were created.
summary.fpReason: No credible benign or deployment explanation is present. The names, sequence, external source IP, destructive logging changes, sensitive-data access, and cryptocurrency-mining resources are directly inconsistent with routine administration.
summary.whatHappened: On 2026-08-19 from 17:49:10 to 18:01:05 UTC in GCP project pocaas-prod-01, mirage@pkwork.onmicrosoft.com, from 198.51.100.42 using a browser user agent, created service account backdoor-svc-gcp@pocaas-prod-01.iam.gserviceaccount.com and key abc123def456, then granted it project roles/owner. The same identity opened allow-all-ingress (0.0.0.0/0), created crypto-miner-01 and crypto-miner-02, read financial-report-2026.xlsx, employee-pii-export.csv, and api-keys-production.json, deleted export-all-logs and disabled the _Default sink, and granted itself Token Creator on deploy-pipeline. The backdoor service account subsequently created crypto-miner-03 at 17:59:05 UTC. Separate eve.hacker attempts from 91.219.236.100 at 17:58:05/20 UTC were denied.

researchDone: Queried GCPAuditLogs for project pocaas-prod-01 and mirage during 17:30–18:30 UTC; found 25 events, no truncation.
Reviewed the full alert window and correlated principal, source IP, methods, requests, responses, authorization results, and resource names.

Checked activity by all principals in the project around the window; deploy-pipeline and named users showed separate internal/admin activity, while mirage uniquely performed the persistence and destructive sequence.
Checked IAM persistence operations specifically; mirage successes were confirmed, while eve.hacker's two analogous attempts were explicitly Permission denied.
No public-web research was needed; the decisive evidence is first-party GCP audit telemetry.
